integrity: The finite census is exhaustively replayable from the embedded verifier; the literature-based originality conclusion is not a proof of bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The census is for direct simplicial self-maps of the fixed seven-vertex triangulation. General continuous torus self-maps, or simplicial maps after subdivision, realize many more homotopy classes.
title: Contiguity over-resolves homotopy on the minimal seven-vertex torus
